requirement: As a visitor, I want to see all 8 tools with their status (Available, Beta, Coming Soon) so I know what I can use today.
issues: Visitor surface (website) has no status badges, no Coming soon/Notify me, no Beta note, and lists 6 products in CHF only. In-app catalogue meets name/description/badge/from-price/waitlist but shows no expected date for Coming soon and no 'features may change' note for Beta. · AC met only for signed-in users in SOS /tools; the story is a visitor story.

requirement: As a visitor, I want prices shown in my country’s currency so I understand the real cost.
issues: No IP country detection and no country selector on any pricing page; the website is CHF-only; plan cards carry no tax incl./excl. label (tax only appears at checkout and G-12 is undecided). · Resolver (country -> zone -> USD, R03) is implemented in the mock and drives in-app prices in the workspace currency.

requirement: As a visitor, I want to switch between monthly and yearly prices so I see how much I save.
issues: Yearly shows the per-year total and saving % but not the monthly equivalent. The website (visitor surface) has no monthly/yearly switch: it sells 1/3/6/12-month terms with 0/5/10/15% savings. · Website model follows its own design (D-000, D-031); no decision reconciles it with spec 03 cycles.

requirement: As a visitor, I want to join the waitlist of a Coming Soon tool so I am told when it launches.
issues: No visitor email form (website has no Notify me); no confirmation email; going Beta/Live only sets waitlist.notified=true: no launch email or in-app notification is created. · Logged-in join uses the account, deduped per tool and workspace.

requirement: As a visitor or owner, I want to request a Custom plan so I get a plan that fits a large team.
issues: Form has tools, seats, cycle, notes only (no name, company, email, phone, country); owner-only and in-app, no visitor form on the website; accepting a quote only sets state=accepted and private plans are filtered out of /tools/:key, so the private plan never appears in the workspace. · Request reaches ADM custom plan requests as New.

requirement: As a visitor, I want to browse services, packages and past projects so I trust OrgTik before I request work.
issues: Package prices only in CHF, not the visitor's currency; portfolio projects have no 'Request a similar project' that pre-fills a service request (CTAs go to the generic contact form). · Services and portfolio content are managed in the Website Manager.

requirement: As a visitor, I want to sign up with email or Google so I can start fast.
issues: No email verification (account created verified); no Google sign-up; password rule is length only (no number); no country pre-fill from IP; language not taken from the site (profile language fixed to en). · Sign-up creates the account and hands over to SOS via one-time code.

requirement: As a new owner, I want to create my workspace so my team has one place to work.
issues: No create-workspace step: name defaults to company or '<first name>'s workspace', slug is generated (not chosen, no uniqueness check shown), country is fixed to CH/CHF, no language or time zone. · General Free line is activated automatically and currency is not locked until the first payment (both met).

requirement: As a new owner, I want to pick my first tools and start a free trial so I can test before paying.
issues: No 'pick your first tools' step at onboarding (trials start one at a time from a tool page later); 'start on Free' is not an action (free plan card links to /billing). · Trial without card and one trial per tool per workspace (409 trial_used, G-17) are met.

requirement: As a new owner, I want to invite my team during onboarding, or skip it, so setup is quick.
issues: No onboarding invite step with several emails and a role each, and no Skip; invites are sent one email at a time from /team after setup.

requirement: As an owner, I want to see all my tools with plan, status, price and renewal date on one page.
issues: No usage bars for main limits (no usage data in the mock); the overview is split between /billing (owner) and /tools; 'Scheduled change' is a notice, not a state. · Plan, state, price as bought in the workspace currency and renewal/trial/grace dates are shown per line.

requirement: As an owner, I want to add a tool and choose its plan and billing cycle so I can grow without re-registering.
issues: New line is not prorated to the existing billing date: it starts its own 30/365-day period (app-api.js:186) and gets its own invoice; checkout carries one plan only. · Plans compared side by side with limits; the tool is active right after payment.

requirement: As an owner, I want to upgrade a plan immediately and pay only the prorated difference.
issues: Summary doesn't show current plan -> new plan, days left or the next renewal amount; the model credits the unused part and restarts a full period instead of charging the prorated difference with the period end unchanged (F-05 step 2). · New limits apply at once (new line active).

requirement: As an owner, I want to downgrade at the end of the period and know what happens to my data.
issues: Defect: the mock never applies a scheduled downgrade (lifecycle.js advance() has no l.scheduled handler), so the plan never changes at period end. Also missing: the list of data over the new limits, and copy says it 'stops working' instead of read-only. · 'Downgrade scheduled on <date>' notice + banner and cancel-before-date work.

requirement: As an owner, I want to remove a tool and be able to restore it within 30 days.
issues: No 'Restore' (an ended line offers 'Subscribe again', a new purchase); cross-tool links don't show 'unavailable'; policy 7.1 not referenced. · Removal works until period end, no refund, ended data deleted after 30 days.

requirement: As an owner, I want to be warned when I get close to a limit so I can upgrade in time.
issues: No usage tracking, no 80%/100% in-app or email warnings, no hard/soft limit blocking, no member 'Ask your admin' variant. · Limits are only listed on plan cards.

requirement: As an owner on a per-user plan, I want to change my seat count and see the cost before I confirm.
issues: No way to change the seat count: seats = active non-guest members; no seat input, no prorated add / next-renewal removal, no min-seat guard. · G-04 seat model is a switch (A default).

requirement: As an owner in a trial, I want reminders before it ends and a clear result when it ends.
issues: No generated reminders at -3 and -1 days (banner from 3 days before, one seeded notification, no email); choosing a plan during a trial replaces the trial at once rather than starting at trial end. · At the end the tool moves to Free or ends with data kept 30 days.

requirement: As an owner, I want to subscribe to a bundle so I pay less for tools I use together.
issues: No bundle page in USR with included tools, tier, normal total and saving; the in-app cart holds one plan so a bundle applies only against owned lines; website bundles are a separate CHF model. · Credit for an owned line's unused period exists (proration credit).

requirement: As a user of a Beta tool, I want to send feedback and be told before billing starts.
issues: No 'Send feedback' anywhere (no in-app Suggestions form); beta billing notice isn't tied to a launch date or a 14-day notice; 'beta data kept' not checkable. · Beta billing banner with launch coupon exists.

requirement: As an owner, I want a clear checkout with total, coupon and tax in my currency.
issues: Coupon isn't checked for currency; payment methods aren't filtered by gateway routing (gateways returned but unused; any saved card shown); cart lines can't be removed and only one line is possible. · Summary has subtotal, credit, bundle, coupon, tax name+rate, total in workspace currency.

requirement: As an owner, I want to manage saved cards so renewals don’t fail.
issues: Gateway hosted fields simulated by brand/last4/expiry (frontend only, D-000); last working card can't be removed while renewals depend on it (409 last_method).

requirement: As an owner, I want to set my billing details so my invoices are correct for tax.
issues: No separate city and postal code (one address textarea); tax/VAT number has no per-country format check. · Country decides tax/currency; after the first payment a country change queues a support migration (R03-C4).

requirement: As an owner, I want to download my invoices in Arabic or English.
issues: No type column (subscription/service); no PDF download and no AR/EN choice (browser print in the UI language); no e-invoice QR.

requirement: As an owner, I want to know when a payment fails and fix it before tools are limited.
issues: No email; no automatic retries on days 1/3/5; the mock has no renewal run, so a day-0 failure exists only in seed data. · Banner + Pay now with saved card (or add one), read-only after 7 days, paying restores at once.

requirement: As an owner, I want to cancel or request a refund and see whether I am eligible.
issues: No refund eligibility or estimate (policy 7.1), no refund request creating a ticket, no refund timing note; 'what I lose' is limited to the end date. · Optional reason captured.

requirement: As an owner, I want reminders before renewal so I am not surprised.
issues: No renewal reminders (7/1 days, 30 for yearly), no amount/card summary, no pay link for non-recurring methods. · Non-recurring gateways are only noted in seed data.

requirement: As a customer, I want to request a service from my dashboard or the website.
issues: No category, attachments, preferred contact/phone; description minimum 20 (spec 30); budget is an amount, not a range; no visitor request form on the website (only paid website orders become requests). · New request shows in My Services as New.

requirement: As a customer, I want to review a quote and accept or reject it before it expires.
issues: No tax line and no payment terms on the quote; no PDF. · Lines, subscriber discount line, total, validity; reject with optional reason; expired quotes refused.

requirement: As a customer, I want to pay the full amount or by milestones.
issues: Milestones have no amount, due trigger or own invoice; only the full amount can be paid. · Work starts (in_progress) after payment.

requirement: As a customer, I want a project page to follow status, messages, files and deliverables.
issues: No status timeline with dates (badge only); messages have no attachments and send no email; deliverables have no versions. · Approve / Request revision on deliveries.

requirement: As a customer, I want to request revisions and see how many are left.
issues: No revisions counter (used / included); extra revisions don't add a quote line. · Requesting a revision works.

requirement: As a customer, I want to approve the delivery and rate the service.
issues: No rating 1-5, review or 'allow on portfolio'. · Approve -> Completed and auto-approve after 7 days (G-30) work.

requirement: As an owner or workspace admin, I want to invite users with a role and tool access.
issues: Tool access is all/some (no none/use/manage levels); invites don't expire and can't be resent. · Revoke (withdraw) and the paid-seat cost warning exist.

requirement: As an owner on Pro or Custom, I want to create custom roles.
issues: No custom roles (name AR/EN, permissions per tool and action) and no plan-based upgrade hint. · /people/:userId/scopes is SOS's staff app-access screen for OrgTik admins, not workspace roles.

requirement: As an owner, I want to deactivate or remove users so seats are freed.
issues: No deactivate (only remove, which frees the seat at once rather than at renewal); no reassignment of open tasks, deals and files on removal.

requirement: As an owner, I want to invite guests to specific projects or files only.
issues: No guest limit per plan (guests are always free); no sharing of specific projects/files: guests get whole tools.

requirement: As a member, I want to see only the tools I can use, and know how to get others.
issues: The rail (apps sidebar) comes from SOS identity grants, not the workspace's tool access; no-access tools are shown on Home with 'Ask your admin' instead of hidden; no lock in the rail for tools the workspace lacks.

requirement: As a user in several workspaces, I want to switch between them quickly.
issues: No workspace logo in the switcher. · Role shown; switching resets all platform data so currency, tools and notifications are per workspace.

requirement: As a user, I want to edit my profile, language and time zone.
issues: Language cookie (D-033) flips direction at once and is saved on the profile; time zone saved.

requirement: As a user, I want to turn on 2FA and see my active sessions.
issues: No 2FA (authenticator, backup codes), no sessions list or sign-out, no owner 'require 2FA'. · Profile states these wait for endpoints.

requirement: As a user, I want to choose which notifications I get and where.
issues: No events x channels preferences grid; no locked billing/security emails for owners. · Only the notification list exists (see USR-24).

requirement: As a user, I want to open a support ticket and follow the replies.
issues: No related tool, attachments or priority; category list is billing/product/sales/technical/other (no 'service'). · Ticket thread, reply (reopens) and resolve work; Waiting for you / Resolved / Closed with auto-close.

requirement: As a user, I want to send suggestions, vote and follow their status.
issues: Nothing in-app; no similar suggestions while typing; voting is a local preview (D-047); no notification when a suggestion's status changes. · Visitors can send ideas that reach WM moderation and see statuses on the roadmap.

requirement: As an owner, I want to export all workspace data or delete my workspace.
issues: No data export (ZIP per tool, emailed link); delete asks for the typed name but not the password. · Data kept 30 days (G-22) and the date is shown.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to edit each tool’s bilingual name, description, icon and order.
issues: Website does not read tools from the platform (only posts website-orders), so edits don't show on the website; ADM-04 fields long description, icon upload (SVG/PNG), brand colour, 'show on website' are absent (icon is a Phosphor preset). · Bilingual name/short description (EN+AR required, D-014 5-language tabs), icon, order editable; key fixed after create; USR shell reads db.tools live.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to set a tool to Coming Soon, Beta or Available.
issues: No expected launch date for Coming Soon; 'Available needs >=1 active public plan with a default price' not enforced (PATCH only checks STATUS_NEXT); trial/checkout APIs don't refuse plans of a coming_soon tool. · Status changes are guarded and logged (S.log tool_status); statuses are coming_soon/beta/live/retired.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to choose open or invite-only beta and invite people from the waitlist.
issues: No open vs invite-only beta mode, no 'invite selected from waitlist', no invited/accepted counts or endpoints. · Going beta only sets waitlist.notified=true for everyone.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to see the waitlist per tool so I can decide launch priority.
issues: No count split by country and visitor/subscriber; no CSV export; no 'Notify all' action (beta/live only flips a notified flag, no email or in-app notice is created). · Per-tool list with tool filter and total count; tools list shows the waitlist count.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to move a tool from Beta to Available with a notice period and launch discount.
issues: No launch dialog: billing start date (+14d), launch coupon, AR/EN message; Beta to Live is a plain confirm. Beta users get no notice. · USR beta_billing banner exists but with a hard-coded coupon LAUNCH20, not driven by ADM.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to define each tool’s features and limits so plans can use them.
issues: Feature name AR/EN and reset period missing; features can't be edited (add/delete only); feature keys are not enforced anywhere server-side (limits only displayed in USR plans). · Key '<tool>.<feature>' (G-20), type flag/limit, unit, hard/soft enforcement, used-by count, in-use delete refused (409).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to create and edit plans for each tool without code changes.
issues: Max seats and billing cycles fields missing; default USD price not editable in the plan editor (create sets 0, PATCH ignores price; grid only edits zone cells). · Tier, name EN/AR, flat/per-user, min seats, guest limit, trial days, yearly discount, visibility, status. No delete endpoint, so subscribed plans can only be archived.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to set the limit values of each plan.
issues: Lowering a limit does not show how many workspaces are already above it. · Each limit: number / Unlimited / not in plan; flags on/off.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to archive a plan so no one new buys it but current subscribers keep it.
issues: Archived plans hidden from USR catalog/plans; existing lines untouched. Optional 'move subscribers at renewal' not built. Checkout quote() does not itself refuse an archived planId (app-api.js:125-131).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to manage currencies with their decimals and rounding.
issues: No AR/EN name, symbol or symbol position; no 'gateways supporting it' column; activation is not blocked when no active gateway supports the currency (only deactivation-in-use is blocked). · ISO code, decimals 0/2/3, rounding step and mode with live example; in-use currency can't be turned off (R03-C5).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to create zones with a base currency and a list of countries.
issues: Zone name is a single string (not AR/EN); countries can't be picked from the zone editor (assigned one by one in the country sheet). · Base currency, active toggle, Default zone that can't be turned off and catches unassigned countries. The old Sales-app conflict no longer applies (ADM follows spec 03).

requirement: As a super admin, I want every country in exactly one zone so a price is never ambiguous.
issues: Moving a country shows no confirmation ('will move from <zone>') and no affected workspaces; the move does not queue migrations (only turning a zone off does, admin-api.js:204-207). · Data model gives each country exactly one zone (countries[iso].zone); workspaces keep their currency.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to set the price of every plan in every zone in one grid.
issues: Empty cell shows the default USD price (grey) only in the Default zone column, other zones show a dash; no bulk change of selected cells by %; no country view toggle. · Rows = plans, column pairs = zones x monthly/yearly in zone currency, tool filter, draft cells 'from -> to'.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to override a country’s currency or price so it can differ from its zone.
issues: Currency-only override (converted + rounded, needs rate R03-X2) or fixed price; fixed wins over zone; grid tags it (violet per D-045, not orange); trash removes it. Note: overrides save immediately, bypassing the draft/publish of F-07.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to set exchange rates between a zone currency and a country currency.
issues: No effective date; the rate row is overwritten (history only as text in the pricing log); no warning or age column for rates older than 30 days; no pricing/reporting purpose. · New rates affect new purchases only (snapshots kept, P6).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to preview the final price for any country before publishing.
issues: Inverted: picks a plan and lists countries, not 'pick a country -> every plan'; no tax, total, rate used or discount; no 'Explain' step view; no 'include draft changes'. · Plan, cycle, seats; price, currency and source per country from the real resolver.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to schedule a price change and decide who it affects.
issues: A future effective date is ignored: publish writes db.grid immediately (admin-api.js:286), so a 'scheduled' change applies to new purchases at once; scheduled price changes on existing lines are never applied at renewal (lifecycle has no renewal step); affected-subscriptions count is computed (draft.affects) but not shown in the review dialog; no notice email/notification to owners; no customer message or notice-days field. · Draft -> review (old vs new, increase/decrease) -> apply mode new_only / existing_next_renewal / existing_now (increase refused, P5), reason required. Old Sales conflict gone.

requirement: As a super admin, I want a log of every pricing change.
issues: No effective date, approver or status (Scheduled/Applied/Cancelled) column; plan/zone/cycle/old/new only inside a free-text summary; no cancel of a scheduled change. · Who, when, action, apply mode, reason, notified count, price version; currency/country/rate edits logged too.

requirement: As a super admin, I want yearly prices calculated from monthly with a discount, or entered by hand.
issues: Grid shows 'from monthly' text instead of the computed yearly amount; a manual yearly cell is not tagged 'Manual'. · Resolver: yearly = monthly x 12 x (1 - plan.yearlyDiscountPct) unless a yearly cell is set; discount per plan (default 2 months free, G-03).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to build bundles of tools with a discount.
issues: No cycles, zones offered or start/end dates. · Name EN/AR, 2+ plans, discount %, active; price = sum of resolved plan prices - % (R03-B1), examples per country; auto-applied in checkout.

requirement: As a super admin, I want coupons that work correctly in any currency.
issues: Missing limits: per workspace, new customers only, zones, duration (once / N cycles / forever); validFrom is not checked at checkout. · Percent works in any currency; fixed needs an amount per currency and fails elsewhere (coupon_currency); total uses, end date, plan scope; redeemed coupon's discount locked (409).

requirement: As sales/support, I want to find a workspace and see its tools, usage, users and invoices.
issues: Search by invoice number missing (name and member email only); no usage view. · Detail shows tools/lines with price source and price version, members, invoices, tickets, requests. Old Sales conflict gone.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to extend a trial, give credit, suspend or reactivate a workspace.
issues: No 'give credit' action (no credit balance in the model). · Extend trial (1-30 d), suspend, reactivate, cancel, note; reason required and audited; suspension banner to everyone in USR.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to migrate a workspace to another currency when its country or zone changes.
issues: Cannot start a migration from a workspace; approval shows currencies and date but not the new resolved prices; approved migrations are never applied at renewal; owner is not notified. · Queue with approve/reject (reason required on reject); migrations only created when a zone is turned off or seeded.

requirement: As support, I want to view a workspace as the customer to troubleshoot.
issues: Guarded by workspaces:edit, not a dedicated 'View as customer' permission; only session start is logged (no end); read-only session and banner live in SOS's View as, reachable only for owners with a local sign-in. · Reason required, audited, read-only by design (D-017 replaced Login as).

requirement: As sales, I want to turn a custom plan request into a private plan for that workspace.
issues: Statuses are new/quoted/accepted, not New/Contacted/Quoted/Won/Lost; no assign salesperson or notes; no 'Create private plan' (limits, cycle, workspace-only visibility); accepting a quote creates no private plan or subscription. · Sales can quote a price in the workspace currency with a validity.

requirement: As finance, I want to see payments and work the failed-payments queue.
issues: No payments list or failed-payments tab; filters only state/workspace/currency (no gateway, date); no 'send pay link' or 'extend grace' actions. · Retry (simulated) and mark paid on open/past-due invoices; past_due filter acts as the queue.

requirement: As finance, I want to issue full or partial refunds with a credit note.
issues: Policy rule (7.1) not shown; refund not tied to the original gateway; credit note has a number but no AR/EN PDF; no 'cancel the line' or 'notify customer' option. · Max refundable shown and enforced, original currency, partial/full, reason required, invoice state updates.

requirement: As finance, I want to create a manual invoice for special cases.
issues: No due date input (set to issue+7d), no pay link, currency not selectable, line description single-language without qty/unit price. · Draft manual invoice with lines in the workspace currency, tax from the country rule, then issue.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to configure payment gateways and route them by country and currency.
issues: No credentials (masked), test/live mode, or add-gateway; countries/currencies/methods not editable; routing is derived from each gateway's countries + priority, no routing rules by zone or explicit fallback. · Priority, recurring, active editable; route tester (country + currency -> ordered gateways); non-recurring gateways labelled 'renews by pay link'.

requirement: As finance, I want tax rules per country so invoices are legal.
issues: Tax name single-language; e-invoicing is free text not none/ZATCA/ETA; no OrgTik tax number or effective date; inclusive/exclusive left open (G-12); invoices use the workspace country's current rule, not the billing country at invoice date. · Country, rate, B2B reverse charge, active.

requirement: As a super admin, I want revenue reports in one base currency.
issues: No filter by currency to show original amounts; no date/zone/tool filters. · Payments keep their day's USD rate; revenue/refunds/MRR in USD; MRR divides yearly by 12.

requirement: As a super admin, I want to manage the services catalog with prices per zone.
issues: No categories tab or new package; no deliverables, duration/revisions, milestone template; zone prices are read-only (packages excluded from the grid, admin-api.js:239). · Name EN/AR, status, delivery days, subscriber discount; per-zone prices shown; 'quote only' label.

requirement: As sales, I want to review a request and send a quote with line items and a validity date.
issues: No payment terms (full vs milestones totalling 100%); quote versions not kept (r.quote overwritten). · Line items, validity, workspace currency, subscriber discount as its own line (default on).

requirement: As a service manager, I want to assign a team to a request.
issues: Single assignee only (no lead + members); assignee is not notified. · Assigned requests appear under the 'mine' filter.

requirement: As a service team member, I want to update status, message the customer and upload deliverables.
issues: Service Team sees every request (services:view lists all; 'mine' is only an optional filter), breaking 'I only see requests assigned to me'; delivering creates no customer notification; files are names only. · Edit actions are limited to own requests (E*, 403 otherwise); deliver moves to in_review; messages and status changes work.

requirement: As a content editor, I want to publish bilingual blog posts, pages and portfolio projects.
issues: No 'single language' flag guarding publication with a language missing. · Draft/review/approved/scheduled/published plus archive and per-language SEO are met; website content is English-only for now (D-037, D-042).

requirement: As a product manager, I want to review suggestions, change status, reply and merge duplicates.
issues: No reply (public or private); merge moves votes but there are no followers to move; no delete. · Declined needs a reason and Shipped needs a link (content.js:460-461).

requirement: As a super admin, I want to edit email and notification templates in both languages.
issues: Only 8 of the ~19 events seeded; no 'send test email'; no RTL/LTR preview. · Subject/body in 5 languages (D-014), variables with unknown-variable check, missing-language badges.

requirement: As a super admin, I want staff accounts with detailed permissions.
issues: Roles are fixed (matrix read-only); no View/Edit/Approve level, no special permissions (approve pricing, issue refund, view as); 2FA not enforced (mock always reports verified). · Assign roles per staff member; module permissions enforced by the API (403 with the required permission); self-lockout guarded.

requirement: As support, I want to handle tickets with priority and SLA.
issues: No SLA timer or overdue highlight; no merge; no canned replies AR/EN; no link to invoice/request. · Assign, public reply, internal note (hidden from customer), priority, resolve/close.

requirement: As a super admin, I want an overview of the business on one screen.
issues: No churn, new sign-ups or active-subscriptions KPI; no charts; no filters (date range, zone, tool). · MRR (USD), workspaces by state, trials, past-due invoices, and work queues (requests, tickets, custom plans, migrations, waitlist).
